_comment: Mini-ARC in context (2026-10-18; data/miniarc_ctx.npz): no task identifiers; each sample stacks 2 demonstration pairs and the query input (5 grids, 125 cells) and the loss covers the query output only (ignore_label0). The recurrent linear-attention memory is written by all 125 cells every block, so the query reads the demonstrations from it (BDH-CQ-like: demonstrations into memory, no identifier table). hidden 32, 2 heads, FFN 64, 8 blocks x 2 segments.
